```{r}
pacman::p_load(caret)

set.seed(999)
n <- nrow(ins)
train_idx <- sample(1:n, floor(0.7 * n))
train_data <- ins[train_idx, ]
test_data <- ins[-train_idx, ]

get_rmse <- function(model, test_df) {
  preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_df)
    is_log <- grepl("log", as.character(formula(model))[2])
  
  if (is_log) {
    preds <- exp(preds)
    actual <- test_df$charges
  } else {
    actual <- test_df$charges
  }
  
  return(sqrt(mean((actual - preds)^2)))
}

rmse_lm_full <- get_rmse(lm_full, test_data)
rmse_lm1     <- get_rmse(lm1, test_data)
rmse_lm2     <- get_rmse(lm2, test_data)
rmse_lm3     <- get_rmse(lm3, test_data)
rmse_lm4     <- get_rmse(lm4, test_data)
rmse_lm5     <- get_rmse(lm5, test_data)
rmse_lm6 <- get_rmse(lm6, test_data)

results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Full", "LM1", "LM2", "LM3", "LM4", "LM5", "LM6"),
  RMSE = c(rmse_lm_full, rmse_lm1, rmse_lm2, rmse_lm3, rmse_lm4, rmse_lm5, rmse_lm6)
)
print(results)

lm_test <- lm(log(charges) ~ age + I(age^2) + sex + bmi + I(bmi^2) + children +  smoker + region + age:sex + age:children + age:smoker + age:region +  sex:smoker + bmi:smoker + children:smoker + smoker:region, data = ins)

summary(lm_test)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 데이터 요약 및 하한/상한값 계산
region_representative <- ins %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    age = mean(age),
    bmi = mean(bmi),
    children = mean(children),
    sex = "male",       # 임의 설정
    smoker = "no"       # 임의 설정
  )

# 2. 모델을 사용하여 예측 구간(Prediction Interval) 계산
preds <- predict(lm2, newdata = region_representative, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)

# 3. 기존 요약 테이블과 결합
final_table <- ins %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    Insurance_Charge = mean(charges),
    sd_val = sd(charges),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # 로그 모델 사용 시 exp()로 복원
    Lower_Limit = exp(preds[, "lwr"]),
    Upper_Limit = exp(preds[, "upr"])
  ) %>%
  select(region, Insurance_Charge, Lower_Limit, Upper_Limit)

print(final_table)
```
